periodic_spline.construction: read HDF5 -> compile -> detect exact circular torus -> cache major/minor/z parameters
periodic_spline.evaluate: native exact algebra when specialized; otherwise CompiledPeriodicSplineSurface::evaluate
periodic_spline.distance: native exact openmc::torus_distance when specialized; otherwise compiled patch solver or explicit reference solver
periodic_spline.normal: native exact algebra when specialized; otherwise compiled surface normal

swept_spline.construction: read one swept payload or dataset collection -> compile surface or top-level coil-set BVH
swept_spline.evaluate: adapter virtual call -> compiled swept surface/set; an exact planar circle currently delegates through an internal CompiledPeriodicSplineSurface
swept_spline.distance: adapter creates RootSearchOptions per call -> compiled swept surface/set; exact planar circle currently reaches the quartic kernel only through two compiled wrappers
swept_spline.normal: adapter -> compiled swept surface/set; exact planar circle currently reaches torus algebra through the internal wrapper

call_graph.ztorus: SurfaceZTorus::distance subtracts its center and calls the shared openmc::torus_distance quartic kernel.
call_graph.ordinary_csg: Cell::contains/Region::evaluate obtains half-space senses from Surface::evaluate; Region::distance dispatches to each candidate Surface::distance; universe fills apply supported cell transforms.
call_graph.dagmc: DAGMCUniverse owns DAGMC cells and delegates geometry queries to DAGMC/MOAB; a CSG cell may fill a DAGMC universe, while transformed DAGMC cells are explicitly rejected by the current architecture.
